note: English names for Emerald Imperium's species, items, moves and balls that Heart & Soul doesn't share, by Imperium's own indexes. Neither hack's source, nor pokeemerald-expansion's, has a licence, so the names are PKHeX's for the engine's ids, and the indexes the engine has no name for are left out.
